# **Optimization & Performance**

Optimization & Performance is a lightweight Fabric client modpack designed to significantly improve Minecraft’s performance while preserving the core vanilla experience.

The pack focuses on increasing FPS, reducing lag, and adding subtle visual and quality-of-life improvements without introducing gameplay changes or complex mechanics.

### **Features**

- Major FPS improvements through modern optimization mods
- Vanilla-friendly visual enhancements
- Connected textures and improved entity animations
- Dynamic lighting and improved clouds
- Small quality-of-life improvements
- Lightweight and fast

### **Client-side only**

This modpack is client-side only and works on all servers and in singleplayer worlds.

### **Goal**

The goal of Optimization & Performance is simple: make Minecraft run smoother and look better while keeping the game feeling completely vanilla.
